title: 1945 State Department document on Nazi-linked companies in Latin America
summary: JASON tells of 1945 State Department document on Nazi-linked companies in Latin America, about 1945 at Nicaragua; Argentina, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, there's a State Department document which talks about how this was in 1945, they'd already realized hundreds of new companies have been set up in Nicaragua and Argentina

plain: A researcher who goes by JASON, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast and drawing on the author Peter Levenda, describes a 1945 document from the State Department, the US government's foreign affairs office. He says it shows officials had already noticed that hundreds of new companies had been set up in Nicaragua and Argentina, which he links to Nazi money and people escaping Germany. If true, it would mean Nazi networks quietly rebuilt themselves in Latin America after the war.
